sources.title: Power BI Service semantic-model editing
sources.relevance: Import-model Power Query, owner/write/build and tenant settings; edits can autosave; field renaming can leave downstream visual references stale. Feature applicability must be checked in the actual tenant.

sources.title: Copying reports
sources.relevance: A report copy still references the original semantic model; copying is not model isolation.

sources.title: Export visual data
sources.relevance: Export limits and active filters can limit output; verify row counts and identity sets instead of assuming a complete bibliography.

sources.title: PDF export
sources.relevance: Report-page PDF is a report rendering route; a full bibliographic deliverable needs its own completeness check.

sources.title: Scheduled refresh
sources.relevance: The regular scheduled-refresh UI does not offer a monthly interval; use an approved monthly Power Automate orchestration where appropriate.

sources.title: Data refresh
sources.relevance: Dynamic data sources can block refresh; fixed base URLs with RelativePath/Query can qualify for documented exceptions. Test the actual query/tenant; no guarantee inferred.

sources.title: PBIX download
sources.relevance: Report-only and full-model downloads have distinct limitations; do not promise a full PBIX for every service item.

sources.title: UTM Windows guide
sources.relevance: Match ARM64 or AMD64 media to the host; official guest tools and valid licensing. This project does not adopt installer-check bypass advice.

sources.title: Power BI Desktop requirements
sources.relevance: Windows-on-ARM cumulative update requirement, WebView2/display requirements and limited certified virtual-desktop environments. UTM needs an empirical compatibility check.

sources.title: Connected apps in ChatGPT
sources.relevance: Availability, plugin installation, provider authorisation and write permissions are separate. The exact user plugin was not exposed in the originating session.
